whenToUse: A university department or faculty site with admissions, research groups, seminars, a course finder and a people directory.
Academic units with many programmes filtered by level, term, format and language.
avoidWhen: A paid online course — use site-course-01.
A city or public-service site — use site-public-01.
a11y: The course finder is role="search" and result counts are announced in a status region; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Give free-seat meters a text value, not only a bar.
